description:
Returns the content of one file. Text files (HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, SVG, plain text) come back as UTF-8 strings and binary files (images, fonts, audio) as base64. The response includes an `encoding` field ("utf8" or "base64") so you know how to interpret `content`. Always returns the real current source as it is being edited (the app's pre with its unpublished draft over it, so an edit chains on the one before), including for apps created or published in a previous session.

Large files are returned in CHUNKS — `content` may be only PART of the file. After each call, check `hasMore`: if true, call this tool again with `offset` set to the returned `nextOffset`, then concatenate the chunks in order. Decode (for binary) or edit only the FULLY reassembled string. `totalLength` is the total length of `content` across all chunks; `length` is this chunk's length. Text files also carry `version` (of the whole file): pass it as `baseVersion` to neblla_edit_file.

maxLength.description: Maximum length of `content` to return in this chunk. The default (20000) stays comfortably under the response-size limit of MCP clients; lower it further if your client still truncates the reply.

offset.description: Where to start reading, in units of the returned `content` (characters for utf8 text, base64 characters for binary). 0 = start of file. Pass the previous response's `nextOffset` to get the next chunk.

name: neblla_get_file
